status_why: Maine posts no count on the night: towns report within two business days and the Secretary posts workbooks after that.
system: No live statewide results. The Secretary of State (Division of Elections) posts unofficial and then final tabulations as Excel workbooks on its results page in the days after the election; ranked-choice races are tabulated centrally the following week. Media (AP, Bangor Daily News) collect town returns on the night

certify.body: the Maine Secretary of State, to the Governor
certify.rule: The Secretary of State tabulates within 20 days after the election (Me. Rev. Stat. tit. 21-A, 722).
certify.local_rule: Towns file returns within two business days (tit. 21-A, 711).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself

scout_plan: Readable with care, but not live. On the night Maine shows 'the Secretary of State posts results in the days after; ranked-choice races are tabulated the next week', with the largest cities' own postings where they can be read. Poll the results page hourly from Nov 4 and read each new workbook (the kit already reads this layout); RCV rounds when posted.
